description: This file defines a C# class 'ImplicitSubscriptionWithLongKeyGrain' within the Orleans framework. The class implements a grain that subscribes to an Orleans stream with a long key type, logs activation and message receipt events, and provides a method to retrieve the current stored value.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscriptionWithLongKeyGrain
classes.description: A Grain class that subscribes to a stream with a long key, handles incoming data, and provides a method to retrieve the last received value.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base activation method to set up stream subscription and initialize state.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Returns the last value received from the stream.
